says: Vitest started from a subfolder with no vitest.config.ts of its own (next/apps/fabrika, for one) loads no config at all, so the 0410 caps and the new host-only guard never run there.
proof: From next/apps/fabrika with CI unset: `vitest list --filesOnly src/start-child.laws.integration.test.ts` printed the file and exited 0, while the same list from the repo root is refused. .agents/ has a throwing vitest.config.ts for this reason; other folders have none. host.yaml relies on this today: it runs `vitest run --root e2e` from next/apps/fabrika with CI cleared.
cost: An agent that cd's into an app folder can start real-Worker or Electron laws on the laptop with no refusal, the same accident the guard is for.
